role: Single-slot UserDefaults record of the most recent meaningful auto-rescore delta (prior/new score) so the dashboard can show a 'score changed' banner; posts a notification when written.
types: PendingScoreChange.Entry: struct Codable — sessionId, priorScore, newScore (0-10 scale), reason, timestamp
toplevel: Entry gets synthesized Codable used by write/read. Notification.Name extension declares pendingScoreChangeWritten.

units.does: JSON-encodes the Entry into UserDefaults key PendingScoreChange.v1 (overwriting any previous entry) and always posts .pendingScoreChangeWritten with the entry as object.

branches.effect: stores data; on encode failure attempt() logs a warning and nothing is stored, but the notification is still posted so an on-screen dashboard shows the banner while a later read() returns the old/no entry

flags.text: Notification is posted even when encoding failed, so the live banner (DashboardV2View observer) and the persisted slot can disagree; banner would vanish on next onAppear read.

units.does: Reads and decodes the Entry from UserDefaults key PendingScoreChange.v1; returns nil if absent or undecodable.

branches.cond: no data stored under the key
branches.effect: returns nil; otherwise decodes with try? — a decode failure is swallowed to nil (no log)

flags.text: Entry.sessionId and Entry.timestamp are written but never read anywhere: read() has no age or session check and the dashboard shows the banner whenever any entry exists (DashboardV2View.swift:275, :356), so a 'score updated 67 → 74' notice for an old session persists across days/sessions until the user taps dismiss.

units.does: Removes UserDefaults key PendingScoreChange.v1 (called when the dashboard banner is dismissed).
